title: Bug 3: should npm-written hook commands fail OPEN when the hook script is missing?
context: npm wires hooks as node "~/.paqad-ai/current/hooks/<file>" with onFailure:block. If the link dangles, every Edit/Write is blocked with MODULE_NOT_FOUND until repaired by hand. A fail-open guard (run only if the script exists) degrades a broken link to 'paqad off' instead of 'all edits blocked', trading the fail-closed guarantee for availability. doctor gains the exact repair command either way.

options.label: Keep fail-closed (onFailure:block); rely on the link-policy fix + doctor repair to prevent dangling. A dangling link still blocks all edits until repaired
Add a fail-open guard to npm hook commands so a missing script = paqad off (no block); broad change across Claude/Codex/Gemini command strings + tests

rationale: Owner keeps the fail-closed guarantee; rely on the link policy + doctor repair command; no cross-host hook-command change
